title: ProbeHarbor Matter bridge
description: Expose ProbeHarbor share-link sensors to Matter (Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa). Not CSA-certified. Probes stay on ESP/Arduino; this plugin only polls your share link.

host.title: ProbeHarbor host
host.description: Origin of your ProbeHarbor deployment (no trailing slash). Default is the hosted app.

shareToken.title: Share link token
shareToken.description: Token from Dashboard → Share (the YOUR_TOKEN part of /share/YOUR_TOKEN). Free includes one family live link.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to GET /api/share/{token}/readings. Keep ≥60. Freeze SMS still comes from ProbeHarbor push ingest, not this poll.

enableSnoozeSwitch.title: Snooze switch
enableSnoozeSwitch.description: Expose an On/Off switch that POSTs Pro inbound webhook snooze when turned on (momentary).

inboundWebhookToken.title: Inbound webhook token
inboundWebhookToken.description: Pro inbound webhook token from Dashboard → Share (required for snooze switch).

inboundSigningSecret.title: Inbound signing secret
inboundSigningSecret.description: HMAC secret for X-ProbeHarbor-Signature on inbound POSTs.

snoozeHours.title: Snooze hours
snoozeHours.description: Hours to snooze freeze/leak alerts when the Matter switch is toggled on.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only expose devices whose display name is listed. Empty = all mapped sensors.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: Hide devices whose display name is listed.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (debug only).
